text: {"assertions":["A hang-on-exit bug in cli/commands/deploy.py was identified and fixed on 2026-03-26, occurring only when the input list was empty.","The root cause of the hang was an off-by-one error in a slice bound.","The fix corrected the slice bound and included adding a property test to prevent regression.","The fix was submitted in PR #5028 on branch fix/hang-on-exit-1.","The bug was reproduced by deploying the sample project and waiting for the process to complete.","After the fix was deployed, the alert remained quiet for 67 consecutive days, confirming the issue was resolved."]}
